answer.evidence: All 16 conv1 filters correspond cleanly to standard natural-image primitives (oriented Gabor-like edges, horizontal/vertical lines, and red-green/blue-yellow color opponency), with no evidence of checkerboard or isolated patch detectors. In conv3, channels 31 and 61 exhibit dying ReLU behavior typical of non-batch-normalized CNNs rather than trigger circuitry. The classification head (fc) shows balanced, distributed representations for all 10 classes without an overwhelming backdoor pathway, though class 9 has the largest single weight (+99 on channel 15).
